card.name: Mortality and serious-risk warning wording
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before risk terms in warnings, especially "mortality" (split as Mort/ality), "malignancies", and "increased risk of" death in antipsychotic dementia warnings. Also fires on a few other warning words like "topical steroids" and "follow" in "follow-up".
